what: On hover the text exits to -150% with inQuint (.64,0,.78,0), and when it is about 85% out, a panel in inverted text color rises from 160% below at .2x scale and fills the area with inOutQuint (.83,0,.17,1). When the panel is 60% full, the same text rises onto the panel from 160% below with outQuint (.22,1,.36,1) — .283s per piece. Reverses on release. Current page link (aria-current=page) stays flipped. Also turns on for keyboard focus (focus-visible)
needs: CustomEase (if available, keeps the original curve as is)

options.out · grow · ease: Curves for text exit, panel rise and text enter — four values, default original inQuint·inOutQuint·outQuint
options.look: With dark, the panel uses --kf-contrast-ink (on a light background, like a link over the white contact panel)

from.where: shared.js header-row menu·contact panel links·All Work — original Action(FanPyzmv): default {duration .85/3, outQuint}, relative -150 inQuint, absolute 160/.2 → 0/1 inOutQuint '>-85%', text 160 → 0 '>-40%', and if the route/contact panel is currently open, keep it on
